WHAT IS MACCARE - MAC CLEANER?

MacCare is a native macOS system cleaner built with safety as the core principle. Unlike traditional Mac cleaners that select everything for deletion, MacCare assigns a color-coded risk level to every single item: green (safe), yellow (low impact), orange (caution), red (risky). Only safe items are selected by default.




Key features include:



Smart Cleanup scanning 8 junk categories in parallel (caches, logs, temp files, app remnants, duplicates, downloads, mail attachments, system junk)
Interactive TreeMap disk visualizer showing exactly where your storage went
Complete app uninstaller detecting remnants across 9 categories (caches, preferences, containers, launch agents, logs, saved state, cookies, application support, other)
Startup optimizer for Login Items, LaunchAgents, and system daemons
Menu bar monitor with always-visible disk space indicator
Audio Producer Mode that protects Logic Pro, Kontakt, Soundtoys, Ableton, Pro Tools, and all DAW-related files with one toggle
Hardcoded safety whitelist preventing deletion of Documents, Photos, Music, Mail, and SSH keys
Full Trash put-back support via native Finder integration
Activity log tracking every cleanup action
English and German language support



Built with SwiftUI, signed and notarized by Apple. Available at $29/year or $69 lifetime with a 7-day free trial.
